name: grok-companion
description: Use the local Grok CLI from Codex for code review, delegated coding tasks, and tracked background jobs.

interface.longDescription: Use the local Grok CLI for structured code reviews, delegated investigations and implementations, and durable background jobs. Requires Node.js, Git for reviews, and an authenticated Grok CLI on the same machine. Designed for Codex CLI and Codex in the ChatGPT desktop app; it does not run in ordinary Chat, mobile, the IDE extension, or hosted environments without the local CLI.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok to review my current changes.
Delegate this investigation to Grok in the background.
Show the status of my recent Grok jobs.
